data.exact_reserve_text: The combined operating ratio of 96.5% was worse than prior year (2015: 90.5%) due to the impact of the Ogden table changes, coupled with a reduced profit contribution from prior years. This result includes the anticipated impact of the recent announcement from the Ministry of Justice, reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. The 2016 result also includes the cost of the 2007 and prior year Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement in respect of the Syndicate's UK & Ireland EL and PL legacy reserves. The 2013 and prior years produced a net profit of GBP 3,648k, following better than expected claims activity, particularly in the Professional Indemnity and General Liability classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 17.115 million, primarily driven by the impact of Ogden discount rate changes, the cost of a Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement for 2007 and prior year legacy reserves, and a general reduced profit contribution from prior years. This adverse development was partially offset by a net profit of GBP 3.648 million for the 2013 and prior years, attributed to better than expected claims activity in Professional Indemnity and General Liability classes. The overall impact contributed to a worsened combined operating ratio compared to the prior year.

The narrative also mentions a specific net release for 2013 and prior years, and general adverse impacts from Ogden rate changes and a Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement.
